tier1.text: The adductor longus adducts the thigh, pulling the thigh toward the midline of the body. This muscle also flexes the thigh, bringing the thigh forward and upward at the hip. In addition, the adductor longus rotates the thigh inward. This muscle lies on the medial side of the thigh, the side toward the body's middle.
